name: Nauru

flag.description: A dark blue field divided by a narrow yellow horizontal stripe across the middle, with a white twelve-pointed star below the stripe near the hoist.
flag.symbolism: The yellow stripe is the equator and the star marks Nauru's position just south of it; the star's twelve points stand for the island's twelve original tribes.

hook: A thin yellow equator line with a twelve-pointed star just below it: Nauru sits just south of the equator, exactly where the star is.
trivia: The flag was adopted on independence day, 31 January 1968.
At about 21 km², Nauru is the third-smallest country in the world, after Vatican City and Monaco.
Nauru has no official capital; government offices are in the district of Yaren.
